ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Visionary
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a strategic and visionary tone, emphasizing future growth and innovation.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven & Objective
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a data-driven and objective tone, focusing on measurable outcomes and facts.

ToneOptions.Label: Confident & Assured
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Project a confident and assured tone, highlighting expertise and successful execution.

ToneOptions.Label: Concise & Actionable
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a concise and actionable tone, facilitating quick understanding and decision-making.

GoalOptions.Label: Secure Investment
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to secure board approval and investment for the proposed cloud infrastructure expansion. Success means demonstrating a clear ROI and strategic necessity, leading to immediate resource allocation for the project.

GoalOptions.Label: Align Technical Strategy
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to align the Board and VP Engineering on the long-term technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure. Success will be achieved when there is a shared understanding and endorsement of the architectural roadmap and key technology choices, ensuring unified direction.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Cloud Risks
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to inform stakeholders about critical risks within our current cloud infrastructure and present a mitigation plan. Success means gaining buy-in for the proposed risk reduction strategies and securing necessary resources to implement them, thereby enhancing system resilience.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Cloud Spend
GoalOptions.Text: This summary seeks to present a compelling case for optimizing our cloud infrastructure spend while maintaining performance. Success is defined by the Board's approval of the cost-saving initiatives and the VP Engineering's commitment to implementing the recommended efficiency improvements.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Viability & Impact
Criteria: Demonstrates clear ROI or cost savings within 18 months.
Aligns with company's strategic growth objectives and market position.
Identifies potential for competitive advantage or new revenue streams.
Quantifies impact on operational efficiency and resource utilization.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Soundness & Scalability
Criteria: Presents a technically feasible and robust architectural plan.
Ensures the solution is scalable to meet projected future demands.
Addresses security, reliability, and performance considerations effectively.
Leverages existing infrastructure and skill sets where appropriate.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Risk Management & Compliance
Criteria: Clearly identifies and quantifies potential technical and operational risks.
Outlines a comprehensive mitigation strategy for identified risks.
Ensures adherence to relevant industry standards and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, SOC2).
Includes a contingency plan for unforeseen challenges or failures.
